purpose: Freeze the benchmark-specific RCC/REVAS -> VERITAS mapping before any new AgentDojo A/B execution.

prior_exposure.interpretation: A future run on this same Banking corpus can be a cleanly frozen integration A/B, but not an unseen held-out validation claim.

arm_b.name: RCC_REVAS_PLUS_VERITAS
arm_b.rcc_surface: same RCC/REVAS gate and candidate semantics as Arm A
arm_b.effect_owner: NativeBindExecutor.Adapter.apply invokes the exact AgentDojo native runtime once

candidate_mapping.source: AgentDojo FunctionsRuntime validated final tool name + Pydantic-normalized arguments immediately before native effect

veritas_candidate_projection.candidate_id: deterministic from frozen AgentDojo candidate hash
veritas_candidate_projection.actor_identity: from independently frozen benchmark authority profile, never from candidate/model prose

request_lineage.context_source: runtime-visible benchmark identity and initial-state metadata only

authority_and_approval.authority_origin: separately generated and signed benchmark-only AuthorityEvidence frozen before execution
authority_and_approval.human_approval_reason: benchmark ActionClassContract v0.1 declares NOT_REQUIRED for this simulation profile
authority_and_approval.claim_boundary: This profile does not test an approval-required branch or production banking authority.

state_and_effect.initial_state_rule: Arm A and Arm B start each enrolled case from independently restored equivalent AgentDojo initial environments.
state_and_effect.snapshot: full runtime-visible AgentDojo environment serialized through the pinned native model/dict surface
state_and_effect.post_dispatch_unknown_rule: An attempted effect without independently established postcondition remains UNKNOWN; do not blind retry.

whole_task.scorer: original pinned AgentDojo native utility/security scoring only
whole_task.later_trajectory_divergence_after_effect: allowed and reported as treatment behavior

governance_metrics: false allow / false block against preregistered mutation policy

unresolved_fields: exact native scorer source hashes and aggregation command
exact NativeDecisionIntentFactory source-pin set for the selected current VERITAS pin
exact Decide receipt origin/persistence verifier configuration
run_freeze_required_before_execution.rule: No AgentDojo clean A/B execution may be described as preregistered until every unresolved field is replaced by an exact frozen value and the gate is explicitly changed in a new reviewable commit.
